proposed_comments.title: Keep overflow tabs reachable
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep overflow tabs reachable

**Severity:** `medium`

The tab items use a horizontal panel, but the `ListView` keeps its default vertical-only scrolling behavior. When the tab titles exceed the available width, later tabs are clipped and cannot be reached; enable horizontal scrolling and disable the unused vertical axis.

```suggestion
            SelectionMode="Single"
            ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
            ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollMode="Enabled"
            ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
            ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollMode="Disabled"
```

confidence.rationale: The tab panel is explicitly horizontal and the current ListView has no horizontal scrolling settings; the literal suggestion built successfully on the pinned upstream head.

proposed_comments.title: Give every tab a stable unique identity
proposed_comments.body:
### Give every tab a stable unique identity

**Severity:** `high`

Please add a stable `ITab.Id` contract, require IDs to be unique within a tabbed page, and use that identity consistently for selection and child caching. Falling back to the page ID, title, or array index allows duplicate or reordered tabs to inherit another tab's selection and cached child; update the toolkit, sample, SDK documentation, and host normalization together.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans the public IDL contract, toolkit implementation, sample IDs, SDK documentation, and host-side duplicate normalization. No single current RIGHT-side range is an independently safe replacement.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The public contract and host cache semantics must change together, so this is a coordinated general review request.

confidence.rationale: The current fallback identity is derived from mutable/non-unique values, and the corrected tree adds explicit IDs plus regression coverage for duplicate and missing IDs.

proposed_comments.title: Invalidate cached children when tab pages change
proposed_comments.body:
### Invalidate cached children when tab pages change

**Severity:** `high`

Please handle `ITab.Page` and identity changes and recreate cached child view models when a dynamic refresh republishes the same tab ID with a different page instance. The current cache is keyed only by the old ID, so a refreshed or mutated tab can continue rendering and querying stale extension data.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The fix coordinates TabViewModel property propagation, dynamic collection refresh, cache-key tracking, child disposal, and selection restoration across multiple host methods rather than one safe inline replacement.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The cache invariant requires coordinated edits across the tab and tabbed-page view models.

confidence.rationale: The stale-child path follows directly from retaining a cache entry by ID after the associated IPage instance changes, and dedicated corrected-tree tests cover both refresh and property-change cases.

proposed_comments.title: Prevent inactive tabs from publishing global UI context
proposed_comments.body:
### Prevent inactive tabs from publishing global UI context

**Severity:** `high`

Please gate command-bar, details, suggestion, and focus messages so only the active child can publish global shell context, then explicitly refresh the newly active child's context. Asynchronous initialization and empty-state updates from a hidden tab can otherwise overwrite the visible tab's command bar or steal search focus; tab switches must also preserve each cached child's search text instead of copying a stale container value over it.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans the shared page context contract and the list, content, parameters, and tabbed-page view models. These message and activation changes are behaviorally incomplete if applied as isolated inline edits.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The active-child publication invariant must be enforced across all participating child view-model types.

confidence.rationale: Several current child paths send global messenger updates unconditionally, including after asynchronous work, and the corrected tree exercises context restoration and inactive-focus suppression.

proposed_comments.title: Harden tab initialization and cleanup races
proposed_comments.body:
### Harden tab initialization and cleanup races

**Severity:** `high`

Please guard both initial and refresh callbacks after cleanup, await each child's async initialization task before treating initialization as complete, and serialize disposal with any in-flight initialization. Without those lifetime checks, navigating away or removing a tab while extension calls are pending can attach handlers to a disposed page, refresh context too early, or clean up a child concurrently with its initializer.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required lifetime fix spans initial population, dynamic refresh, lazy child creation, initialization completion, and cleanup sequencing. It cannot be reduced to one independently correct current diff range.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The race closes only when all initialization and disposal boundaries use the same lifetime rule.

confidence.rationale: The current relay-command invocation starts asynchronous work without awaiting ExecutionTask and has callbacks that can run after cleanup; the corrected tree adds disposed guards and targeted lifecycle coverage.

proposed_comments.title: Cleanly deactivate the inner frame
proposed_comments.body:
### Cleanly deactivate the inner frame

**Severity:** `high`

Please detach the previous inner page when an unsupported tab is selected, clear the inner frame back stack after tab navigation, and use the existing deferred post-navigation cleanup path instead of forcing a synchronous full GC. Collapsing the frame alone leaves the old page registered for global keyboard messages, repeated tab switches retain navigation entries indefinitely, and synchronous collection can pause the UI. Nested tabbed children should also resolve to the unsupported placeholder rather than a blank frame.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction coordinates unsupported-child handling, view-model factory behavior, frame content/navigation cleanup, command-context restoration, and navigation-time resource release across multiple files.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: These frame-lifetime behaviors must be changed together to avoid leaving either hidden views or blank nested content.

confidence.rationale: The current frame is only collapsed, every Navigate journals a new entry, and the navigation callback forces GC; the corrected tree removes all three observable lifetime hazards.
